products.label: Caldwell & Romanowsky (2016) globular clusters, CDS J/ApJ/824/42
products.process: Place each of the table's clusters at its sky position, at a depth along the sight line drawn from the cluster system's published projected profile taken as round, around M31's world origin.
limitations: A cluster's depth is drawn from the system's radial profile, not measured.
The profile is taken as round; the metal-rich inner clusters lie like M31's disc (Caldwell & Romanowsky 2016).
